text_block_list.text:
With a three-generation victory for the 
"Noble Clan" on the line, all eyes are on 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. KS Miracle also 
comes to cheer her on.

Entrusted with a new mission, Daiichi Ruby 
prepares for her first target race. She 
receives a declaration of war from Daitaku 
Helios, a proven contender with graded 
race victories.

However, she pays no mind to even the 
strongest rivals. Her eyes are fixed on 
what lies beyond the finish line. Vowing 
to run faster than anyone else, she steps 
onto the track—!
